item.title: ‘EI8HT’ Is No. 1: Shinedown Tops Hard Rock Album & Song Charts
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the show. We're talking music and milestones, and Shinedown is making headlines. Their brand new album, EI8HT, is debuting at number one on Billboard's Top Hard Rock Albums chart.
[Short music clip from Shinedown]
Host: Released on May 29, EI8HT earned 38,000 equivalent album units in the US, with 30,000 of those coming from album sales. That's impressive, especially with 9,000 of those sales being vinyl copies. The album also landed at number 5 on the Vinyl Albums list.
[Short pause]
Host: This is Shinedown's fifth consecutive number one on the Top Hard Rock Albums chart, starting with Amaryllis back in 2012. And if that's not enough, EI8HT also entered the all-genre Billboard 200 chart at number 12. Every one of Shinedown's full-length albums since 2008 has debuted in the top 20.
[Short music clip from "Young Again"]
Host: But that's not all - the album's single, "Young Again", is also topping the Hot Hard Rock Songs chart. With 1.3 million streams and 183,000 radio audience impressions, it's Shinedown's first number one on this chart. And get this - six tracks from EI8HT are currently on the Hot Hard Rock Songs chart, including "Safe and Sound" at number 6.
[Short pause]
Host: Shinedown is clearly on a roll, and we can't wait to see what's next. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one.
[Outro music plays]
